description: Holds USDJPY while its 50-day average is above its 200-day average, cash otherwise. The yen is the classic policy-driven trending currency. Falsified if Bank of Japan interventions break the trend too often. Backtested on FinzData FX daily closes (spot: the price change only, no interest differential), costs as stated, re-run free on full history.
title: USDJPY trend · 50/200 moving average (spot)
